name: 5-MeO-NET
summary: 5-MeO-NET, also known as 5-methoxy-N-ethyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor agonist and serotonin releasing agent of the tryptamine family.

pharmacology.text: 5-MeO-NET is a potent full agonist or near-full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors. The drug is a relatively weak serotonin releasing agent. It does not produce the head-twitch response (HTR), a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in rodents, suggesting that it would not be hallucinogenic in humans.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonin releasing agent

uses.text: 5-MeO-NET was not included nor mentioned in Alexander Shulgin's book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved).
